is_anopheles.evidence: Adult Anopheles gambiae s.l. (predominantly An. coluzzii, 77%) and An. funestus s.l. were collected during the field trial (page 5, 'Morphological identification' and 'Molecular species identification'; page 7, 'Results').

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study does not genotype any insecticide-resistance markers. In the introduction/study area section (page 3), it only references background frequencies of vgsc-995F (61.5%) and vgsc-1570Y (15.6%) from a separate study under review (Allan et al., Lancet Infectious Diseases 2025).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No primary genotype counts, allele counts, or number of mosquitoes genotyped for resistance markers are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: Adult mosquitoes were collected from IDP camps (Sabon Gari and Doro) in Maiduguri LGA, Borno State, Nigeria between July 2024 and March 2025 (page 3, 'Study area and design').

is_primary_study.evidence: The paper is a primary field trial evaluating attractive targeted sugar baits (ATSB) in IDP camps (page 3, 'Study area and design').

sub_country_location.evidence: The trial took place in Sabon Gari (11°50′50.4″N, 13°06′32.0″E) and Doro (11°52′51.1″N, 13°07′00.8″E) IDP camps in Maiduguri LGA, Borno State, Nigeria (page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Field trial and collections were carried out from July 2024 through March 2025 (pages 4–5).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine field trial data; mentions of resistance frequencies are explicitly cited from a companion paper under review.

supplement.evidence: Supplementary materials list species identification (ITS2/COI) and vector counts, but no resistance marker genotyping was performed.

assessment.summary: This study is a community-level field trial in two internally displaced persons camps in Maiduguri, Borno State, Nigeria, evaluating the entomological efficacy of attractive targeted sugar baits (ATSB). Although background frequencies of vgsc-995F and vgsc-1570Y are cited from another study under review, no resistance marker genotyping was performed in this paper.
exclusion_reasons: Does not genotype any target insecticide-resistance markers (only cites background vgsc data from an unpublished study under review).
No extractable resistance marker genotype data reported.
